# klaviyo_flow (Data Source)

Look up an existing Klaviyo flow by id. Note: Klaviyo's read endpoint does not return the FlowDefinition blob, only the surface metadata.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Flow id.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `created` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `trigger_type` (String)
- `updated` (String)
